sources.snippet: We are excited to open-source Qwen-Image-2.1, a unified text-to-image generation and image editing model in the Qwen family. With just 7B parameters in its visual generation component (32 Single-Stream DiT layers), Qwen-Image-2.1 balances generation quality, inference efficiency, and versatility. sources.snippet: Qwen-Image-2.1 is a new 7B parameter text-to-image generation and image editing model by Qwen which runs locally on 11GB VRAM with GGUFs and 24GB with INT8/FP8. This guide shows you how to run Qwen-Image-2.1 for image gen along with memory requirements, recommended settings and more.
